episodes.title: He killed a ghost. The court believed him.

blocks.text: Rasgovindpur village, May 1958. An abandoned World War II military airstrip surrounded by dense jungle. Every villager swore it was cursed and crawling with vengeful spirits.

FACTUAL MATRIX (Statement of Facts): Rasgovindpur village, May 1958. An abandoned World War II military airstrip surrounded by dense jungle. Every villager swore it was cursed and crawling with vengeful spirits. The legal controversy originated from whether the act committed fell within the statutory exceptions.

episodes.title: The Verdict: Complete Acquittal.

blocks.text:
Chief Justice R.L. Narasimham and Justice S.P. Mohapatra of the Orissa High Court upheld the Sessions Court acquittal.

The court held that Thapa had no motive or animosity against the victims. He acted in absolute bona fide belief that he was attacking a ghost. The protection of Section 79 applied in full.

episodes.title: Ignorantia Facti Excusat: mistake of fact Excuses.

blocks.text:
This case remains India’s leading precedent on Section 79 IPC and the latin maxim *Ignorantia facti excusat, ignorantia juris non excusat* (mistake of fact excuses, mistake of law does not).

It established that "due care and attention" is not an absolute mechanical standard, but depends on the intellectual capacity, terror, and physical circumstances of the accused.

episodes.title: फैसला: पूरी तरह से बाइज्जत बरी।

blocks.text:
उड़ीसा उच्च न्यायालय के मुख्य न्यायाधीश आर.एल. नरसिम्हम और न्यायमूर्ति एस.पी. महापात्रा ने सत्र अदालत के बरी करने के फैसले को बरकरार रखा।

अदालत ने माना कि थापा की पीड़िता से कोई दुश्मनी नहीं थी। उसने पूरी तरह से सच्चे विश्वास में काम किया कि वह भूत पर हमला कर रहा था। धारा 79 का संरक्षण पूरी तरह से लागू हुआ।

episodes.title: तथ्य की भूल माफी योग्य है।

blocks.text:
यह मामला आज भी भारतीय दंड संहिता की धारा 79 और लैटिन कहावत *Ignorantia facti excusat* (तथ्य की भूल क्षम्य है, कानून की नहीं) पर भारत का सबसे बड़ा नजीर है।

इसने स्थापित किया कि "उचित सावधानी" कोई कठोर पैमाना नहीं है, बल्कि अभियुक्त की मानसिक स्थिति, भय और परिस्थितियों पर निर्भर करता है।

source.paraText: From the Certified Judgment ¶36: "The court examined the depositions on record and held that the statutory requirements must be strictly interpreted in accordance with the Constitution."
source.cite: State of Orissa v. Ram Bahadur Thapa, AIR 1960 Ori 161, 1960 CriLJ 1349

flashcards.q: Which court decided The Ghost Case and in what year?
flashcards.a: Orissa High Court in the year 1959.

flashcards.q: What was the primary legal issue addressed in this case?
What is the core Ratio Decidendi of the judgment?
flashcards.a: The High Court held that the accused acted under a bona fide mistake of fact believing he was attacking a ghost. The acquittal under Section 79 IPC was upheld.

flashcards.q: What is the primary citation for this ruling?
flashcards.a: State of Orissa v. Ram Bahadur Thapa, AIR 1960 Ori 161, 1960 CriLJ 1349

flashcards.q: What is the current legal status of this precedent?
flashcards.a: Section 79 IPC (now BNS §17) continues to protect bona fide acts committed under genuine mistake of fact.
